National to Airport turning, PWD, Shogunle, Ladipo is better but approaching Bolade intersection is a slow movement due to traffic light alternation at Bolade junction.

The return journey back to Ikeja from Bolade is perfectly good, likewise Ajayi farm connecting Mongoro, Cement down to Dopemu bridge for now.

Flash flood along Ikeja axis also contributed to slow traffic movement within the axis.

#FollowLASTMA

PAALALA SA PAGGAMIT NG DOXYCYCLINE

Nagpaalala si Quezon City Epidemiology & Surveillance Division Chief Rolando Cruz na kailangan ng konsultasyon mula sa isang health professional bago gumamit ng doxycycline.

Ang doxycycline ay isang uri ng antibiotic na karaniwang iniinom kontra leptospira na nagdudulot ng sakit na leptospirosis.

“Kapag alam natin na lulusong tayo sa baha, puwede tayong mag-take ng doxycycline. Para naman dun sa mga na-expose, mayroon din tayong protocol [kung] ilang araw ka dapat iinom ng doxycycline,” saad ni Dr. Cruz sa panayam sa “One Balita Pilipinas” sa One PH.
